title: kpidash service status
description: Payload of kpidash:services:{name}:{host} — latest-value, no TTL, reader-owned staleness via ts, where the window is the CONSUMER'S and is per service rather than a number this schema fixes: kpidash's default is 60 s, and a daily publisher gets its own (`kmon` has had 26 h since kpidash sprint 018, and publishes this key once per nightly). See kpidash's docs/CLIENT-PROTOCOL.md §8a. There is deliberately no cadence field in the payload — the shape has two consumers and adding one was declined (korg:2309). Key is always 4 segments; {host} sentinel `_` means no host. Identity is (name, host); the key is authoritative over any payload echo.

ts.description: Unix seconds (float) of last payload; drives staleness

text.description: Short status text shown on the card

host.description: Echo of the key's host segment, display only

x-counterexamples.why: the state enum is lower-case and closed; a capitalised twin renders as an unknown state, which is the colour a reader least expects
`text` is required — a service card with a colour and no words is a light nobody can act on
`unhealthy` is the word this contract uses for that; a synonym is a new state the consumer has no ladder for
